Adoption Dataset:

```{r}
# Create new Breed column to update Breed names
filter_new_column <- adoptable_pets %>%
  mutate(Breed_Update = Breed) %>%
  relocate(Breed_Update, .after = Breed)

# Need to remove - Filter on DOG, remove Mutts and Pit Bulls for only purebreds
# Comment out !str_dect to look at all adopted dogs. Is there a better way to do this?
filter_type <- filter_new_column %>% 
  filter(Type == "DOG") %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Breed, "/")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Breed, "&")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Breed, ",")) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Breed, regex("pit\\s*bull", ignore_case = TRUE)))
#identity()


# Update to proper case text
filter_type <- filter_type %>%
  mutate(
    Breed_Update = str_to_title(Breed_Update),
    Breed_Update = str_squish(Breed_Update),
    Breed = str_to_title(Breed),
    Breed = str_squish(Breed)
  )
```

unmatched_rows_specific_AKC <- AKC_merge %>%
      filter(is.na(group))

      filter(is.na(group))

1.  Does AKC popularity influence adoptions?

```{r}
akc_long <- akc_popular_ranking %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Ranking."), as.character)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Ranking."),
    names_to = "Ranking.Year",
    values_to = "Rank"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Ranking.Year = as.numeric(gsub("Ranking\\.", "", Ranking.Year)),
    Rank = as.numeric(Rank)
  )


akc_adopt <- filter_type %>%
  mutate(Outcome.Date = mdy(Outcome.Date),
    OutcomeYear = year(Outcome.Date)) %>%
  left_join(akc_long, by = c("Breed_Update" = "Breed", "OutcomeYear" = "Ranking.Year")) %>% 
  filter(OutcomeYear >= 2013 & OutcomeYear <= 2023) %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "ADOPTION")


akc_adopt_summary <- akc_adopt %>%
  group_by(Breed_Update, OutcomeYear, Rank) %>%
  summarise(Adoptions = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(akc_adopt_summary, aes(x = Rank, y = Adoptions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  #scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Does AKC Popularity Influence Shelter Adoptions?",
    x = "AKC Popularity Rank (1 = Most Popular)",
    y = "Number of Adoptions (per breed per year)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

Yes AKC does influence number of adoptions :)

2.  What is the turn around duration for adoption and what variables influence it? What are the favorable/unfavorable variables when adopting a dog?

```{r}
adopt_feat <- filter_type %>%
  left_join(feat_desc_name_renamed, by = c("Breed_Update" = "Breed")) %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "ADOPTION") %>% 
  mutate(Days.in.Shelter = as.numeric(Days.in.Shelter))

turnaround_stats <- adopt_feat %>%
  summarise(
    mean_days  = mean(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_days = median(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_days = sd(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
turnaround_stats

adopt_hist <- ggplot(data = adopt_feat, aes(x = Days.in.Shelter)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Days in Shelter for Adopted Dogs",
    x = "Days in Shelter",
    y = "Count of Dogs Adopted"
  )

ggplotly(adopt_hist)


model <- lm(
  Days.in.Shelter ~ Sex + Size + energy_level_category + trainability_category + demeanor_category + min_ht..cm. + max_ht..cm. + min_wt..kg. + max_wt..kg. + min_life..yrs. + max_life..yrs. + Affectionate.With.Family + Good.With.Young.Children + Good.With.Other.Dogs + Shedding.Level + Coat.Grooming.Frequency + Drooling.Level + Coat.Length +
    Intake.Type + Intake.Condition + Outcome.Condition,
  data = adopt_feat
)

summary(model)
```

3.  Do popular dogs ever come up for adoption? How quickly do they get adopted compared to less popular breeds?

```{r}
akc_adopt <- filter_type %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome.Date = mdy(Outcome.Date),
    OutcomeYear = year(Outcome.Date),
    Days.in.Shelter = as.numeric(as.character(Days.in.Shelter))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    akc_long,
    by = c("Breed_Update" = "Breed", "OutcomeYear" = "Ranking.Year")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Outcome.Type == "ADOPTION",
    OutcomeYear >= 2013,
    OutcomeYear <= 2023
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    popularity_group = case_when(
      Rank <= 10 ~ "Top 10",
      Rank <= 50 ~ "Rank 11–50",
      TRUE ~ "Rank 51–200"
    ),
    popularity_group = factor(popularity_group,
       levels = c("Top 10", "Rank 11–50", "Rank 51–200"))
  )

# Review data for outliers
#akc_filter <- akc_adopt %>% 
 # filter(popularity_group == "Top 10") %>% 
#  arrange(desc(Days.in.Shelter)) %>% 
 # select(Breed, Breed_Update, Days.in.Shelter, Intake.Type, Intake.Subtype, Intake.Condition, Outcome.Subtype, Outcome.Condition, Rank)


# Count of popular dogs in shelter - Yes popular dogs do come up for adoption. Not as many popular dogs compared to the 50-200 ranked dogs
akc_adopt %>%
  group_by(popularity_group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_days = median(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_days   = mean(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# How quickly do they get adopted compared to less popular breeds?
ggplot(akc_adopt, aes(popularity_group, Days.in.Shelter)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Adoption Speed by AKC Popularity",
    x = "Popularity Group",
    y = "Days in Shelter (log scale)"
  )

# Review Outliers for see the common characteristics
outlier_limits <- akc_adopt %>%
  group_by(popularity_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(Days.in.Shelter, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Days.in.Shelter, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR,
    upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  )

outlier_limits

outliers <- akc_adopt %>%
  left_join(outlier_limits, by = "popularity_group") %>%
  filter(
    Days.in.Shelter < lower |
    Days.in.Shelter > upper
  ) %>%
  select(Breed_Update, Days.in.Shelter, popularity_group, Intake.Date, Intake.Type, Intake.Subtype, Intake.Condition, Outcome.Subtype, Rank) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Days.in.Shelter))

outliers

```

4.  What variables are most impactful for sheltering euthanized dogs?

```{r}
Euthanized <- filter_type %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE") %>% 
  mutate(Days.in.Shelter = as.numeric(Days.in.Shelter)) %>% 
  group_by(Outcome.Subtype) %>% 
  summarise(median_days = median(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_days   = mean(Days.in.Shelter, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

Euthanized %>%
  select(Outcome.Subtype, mean_days, median_days) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_days, median_days),
               names_to = "statistic",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Outcome.Subtype, y = value, fill = statistic)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean vs Median Days in Shelter by Euthanasia Subtype",
    x = "Outcome Subtype",
    y = "Days in Shelter",
    fill = "Statistic"
  )  +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")

# Explain Outcome.Subtype = AGED, find mean/median of euthanized dogs
filter_type %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE") %>% 
  group_by(Outcome.Subtype) %>%
   mutate(
    Intake.Date = mdy(Intake.Date),
    Date.Of.Birth = mdy(Date.Of.Birth)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Age.Upon.Intake.Date = as.numeric(Intake.Date - Date.Of.Birth), 
         Age_Years = floor(Age.Upon.Intake.Date / 365),
         Age_Days  = Age.Upon.Intake.Date %% 365) %>% 
  summarise(
    median_age_years = floor(median(Age.Upon.Intake.Date, na.rm = TRUE) / 365),
    median_age_days  = median(Age.Upon.Intake.Date, na.rm = TRUE) %% 365,
    mean_age_years   = floor(mean(Age.Upon.Intake.Date, na.rm = TRUE) / 365),
    mean_age_days    = floor(mean(Age.Upon.Intake.Date, na.rm = TRUE) %% 365),
    n = n()
  )

#Outcome.Type = EUTHANIZE, Outcome.Subtype = AGED, look at the 3 dogs
# 1 dog is 15 yrs old, 2 are unknown. Outcome condition is untreatable
filter_type %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE",
         Outcome.Subtype == "AGED") %>% 
  select(Name, Breed, Size, Date.Of.Birth, Intake.Subtype, Outcome.Subtype, Outcome.Condition)

# Outcome.Condition = UNTREATABLE
filter_type %>% 
  filter(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE",
         Outcome.Subtype == "AGGRESSIVE") %>% 
  group_by(Outcome.Condition) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n()
  )

# Breed type - doesn't add much value
filter_type %>%
  group_by(Breed_Update) %>%
  summarise(
    breed_Euth_n = sum(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_n = n(),
    rate = breed_Euth_n / total_n
  ) %>%
  filter(breed_Euth_n > 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(rate))

# Count of Dogs by Intake Condition for Euthanasia Subtype
filter_type %>%
  filter(Outcome.Type == "EUTHANIZE") %>%
  mutate(Days.in.Shelter = as.numeric(Days.in.Shelter),
         Outcome.Subtype = factor(Outcome.Subtype,
      levels = c("AGGRESSIVE", "ILL SEVERE", "BEH SEVERE", "CON SEVERE", "INJ SEVERE", "UNDERAGEWT", "AGED")   
    )
         ) %>%
  group_by(Outcome.Subtype, Intake.Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Intake.Condition, y = n, fill = Intake.Condition)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome.Subtype) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Count of Dogs by Intake Condition for Euthanasia Subtype",
    x = "Intake Condition",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none")
```
